resources.string: Follow your music, one line at a time.

Shows three lines below the lock-screen music player and follows playback and seeking. When enabled, song title and artist are sent to LRCLIB to find matching lyrics. Uses the internet and stays hidden on the always-on display.

Adapted from Project Infinity X. Lyrics availability depends on LRCLIB and the metadata supplied by your music app. Instrumental tracks and songs without a matching synchronized recording show no lyrics.
